## Job description
**Analytics Engineer** (fictional test posting)

Our analysts spend too much time fixing broken models, and every team defines "active customer" differently. You'll own our dbt project, raise data quality and make trusted data easy to use.

Responsibilities
- Own and grow the dbt project on BigQuery
- Add testing, documentation and CI/CD to our data models
- Agree shared metric definitions with product and finance
- Coach analysts on SQL and modelling best practice

Requirements
- Advanced SQL and dbt
- Dimensional modelling
- Git and CI/CD
- BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse

Nice to have
- Python
- Airflow
- Looker or Power BI
- Data governance experience

## Company brief
Helio Energy is a Series B renewable energy supplier with 250 staff. Values: be curious, be kind. Stack: BigQuery, dbt, Looker, GitHub Actions.
